prerequisites: Having passed at least 120 ECTS of the study plan for the degree the student is pursuing, both in bachelor's and double bachelor's degrees.

learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive training of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate knowledge of the work methodology appropriate to the professional reality in which students will have to operate as graduates, contrasting and applying the knowledge acquired.
Prepare students for the development of teamwork.
Promote the development of students' decision-making capacity and critical spirit.

syllabus_topics: Design of a training project, specifying educational objectives and professional activities for the internship agreement.
Particular conditions of each internship position, collected in an annex to the agreement, with approval from the assigned center.
Standardized educational contract models, signed by the student, two tutors, and the Center's Internship Program Manager.
assessment_rules: The final grade is obtained by the formula 0.5 * Internship Report Grade + 0.5 * Monitoring Grade. A minimum of 4 points must be obtained in the Internship Report Grade and the Monitoring Grade to pass the course. The final grade must be greater than or equal to 5 to pass. If the minimum is not reached in either the Internship Report Grade or the Monitoring Grade, the maximum final grade will be 4 points. Extraordinary calls will follow the same procedure as the ordinary one.
